interface.name: Lua
interface.summary: powerful, efficient, lightweight, embeddable scripting language
interface.description: Lua is a powerful, efficient, lightweight, embeddable scripting language. It supports procedural programming, object-oriented programming, functional programming, data-driven programming and data description. Lua combines simple procedural syntax with powerful data description constructs based on associative arrays and extensible semantics, is dynamically typed, runs by interpreting bytecode with a register-based virtual machine, and has automatic memory management with incremental garbage collection.
